{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
ds = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
ds['revenue'] = ds['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
ds_clean = ds[ds['revenue'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Filter to only converted customers (converted == 1), regardless of status
converted_customers = ds_clean[ds_clean['converted'] == 1].copy()

# Exclude those with age = -1 (missing data)
converted_customers_valid_age = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age_converted = converted_customers_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result and the count
print(f"Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age_converted}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(converted_customers_valid_age)}")"}
